subject: LINE clause
notes: 'When the first line number of the report group has been calculated, the report's LINE-COUNTER is set equal to that line number and the line is now printed on the page at that vertical location.' BOTH halves in ONE method: PresentLine assigns LINE-COUNTER before composing the line (so a SOURCE IS LINE-COUNTER item prints THIS line's number) and then travels the print stream to that page line. The second half was WRONG until kb/Work PB484: the travel was computed as `target - _physLine` from a page whose stream already rests ON line 1, so line number n printed on page line n+1 and every report opened one line low. The travel is now target-1 while the page is still empty and target - _physLine after a line has been printed on it. The golden numbers every physical line, blanks included, and reads LINE-COUNTER back through 8.4.3.15.3 SR1: FIRST on line 1, SECOND on line 3, MORE on line 4, THIRD on line 7, LINE-COUNTER 7.
